title: Fintech & Wallets
tagline: E-wallets, payment gateways, and banking tools
description: Nepal's payment landscape — eSewa and Khalti dominate consumer wallets, while ConnectIPS/NCHL operate the rails. Khalti has the most polished cross-platform official SDK story; community SDKs fill gaps for the rest. Cryptocurrency is illegal in Nepal — no crypto integrations are listed.
